AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM filtered_relation_orders f_rel WHERE f_rel.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM filtered_relation_orders f_rel WHERE f_rel.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM filtered_relation_orders f_rel WHERE f_rel.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM filtered_relation_orders f_rel WHERE f_rel.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn )

AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM filtered_relation_orders risk_rel INNER JOIN po_facts risk_po ON risk_po.order_sn = risk_rel.order_sn WHERE risk_rel.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn AND risk_po.delivery_status IN ('IN_TRANSIT_OVERDUE', 'COMPLETED_OVER_SLA') )

mapper.sql:
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN COALESCE(pf.current_node, '') = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN pf.order_timeliness = 'OVERDUE' AND COALESCE(pf.current_node, '') <> 'COMPLETED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, pf.created_at ASC, pf.plan_sn ASC
CASE WHEN COALESCE(pf.current_node, '') = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(pf.current_node, '') <> 'COMPLETED' AND pf.delivery_status IN ('IN_TRANSIT_OVERDUE', 'COMPLETED_OVER_SLA') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, pf.created_at ASC, pf.plan_sn ASC
CASE WHEN COALESCE(pf.current_node, '') = 'COMPLETED' THEN 3 WHEN pf.order_timeliness = 'OVERDUE' THEN 0 WHEN pf.delivery_status IN ('IN_TRANSIT_OVERDUE', 'COMPLETED_OVER_SLA') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, pf.created_at ASC, pf.plan_sn ASC
CASE WHEN pf.current_node = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, pf.created_at ASC, pf.order_lead_hours DESC, pf.max_delivery_hours DESC, pf.achievement_rate ASC, pf.plan_sn ASC
pf.created_at DESC, pf.plan_sn DESC
pf.order_lead_hours pf.max_delivery_hours pf.achievement_rate
ASC DESC
, pf.plan_sn ASC
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plan_facts pf WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT pf.plan_sn, pf.product_name, pf.sku, pf.status_text, pf.approval_status, pf.created_at, pf.approval_at, pf.plan_qty, pf.purchase_qty, COALESCE(fpp.related_order_count, 0) AS related_order_count, fpp.order_sns, fpp.buyers, fpp.suppliers, fpp.warehouses, pf.last_po_created_at, pf.order_lead_hours, pf.order_timeliness, pf.order_coverage_confirmed, pf.current_node, pf.max_delivery_hours, pf.delivery_status, pf.allocation_available, pf.inbound_qty, pf.achievement_rate, pf.returned_qty, pf.exchange_qty FROM plan_facts pf LEFT JOIN filtered_plan_projection fpp ON fpp.plan_sn = pf.plan_sn WHERE 1 = 1
LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT DISTINCT po.buyer FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN po_facts po ON po.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE po.buyer IS NOT NULL AND po.buyer <> '' ORDER BY po.buyer
SELECT DISTINCT po.supplier FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN po_facts po ON po.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE po.supplier IS NOT NULL AND po.supplier <> '' ORDER BY po.supplier
SELECT DISTINCT po.warehouse FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN po_facts po ON po.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE po.warehouse IS NOT NULL AND po.warehouse <> '' ORDER BY po.warehouse
mapper.sql: pof.order_id, pof.order_sn, #{planSn} AS plan_sn, pof.skus, pof.product_names, pof.status_text, pof.supplier, pof.warehouse, pof.buyer, pof.settlement_method, pof.settlement_type, pof.source_type, pof.created_at, pof.approval_at, pof.sent_at, pof.purchase_qty, pof.receipt_sns, pof.receipt_count, pof.inbound_sns, pof.inbound_count, pof.valid_inbound_qty, pof.completion_inbound_sn, pof.completion_at, pof.delivery_hours, pof.delivery_status, pof.current_node, CASE WHEN poa.allocation_available = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS allocation_available, CASE WHEN poa.allocation_available = 1 THEN poa.allocated_qty ELSE NULL END AS allocated_qty

sql.if: AND ( rel.plan_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pof.order_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pof.skus LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pof.product_names LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pof.supplier LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pof.receipt_sns LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pof.inbound_sns LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN po_facts pof ON pof.order_sn = rel.order_sn LEFT JOIN plan_order_allocation poa ON poa.plan_sn = rel.plan_sn AND poa.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn}
ORDER BY pof.created_at ASC, pof.order_sn ASC

SELECT CONCAT(rel.plan_sn, '::', pof.order_id, '::', COALESCE(HEX(psf.sku), 'NO_SKU')) AS row_key, pof.order_id AS order_id, pof.order_sn AS order_sn, rel.plan_sn AS plan_sn, psf.sku AS sku, psf.product_name AS product_name, pof.status_text AS status_text, pof.supplier AS supplier, pof.warehouse AS warehouse, pof.buyer AS buyer, pof.settlement_method AS settlement_method, pof.settlement_type AS settlement_type, pof.source_type AS source_type, pof.created_at AS created_at, pof.approval_at AS approval_at, pof.sent_at AS sent_at, psf.purchase_qty AS purchase_qty, COALESCE(rss.receipt_sns, '') AS receipt_sns, COALESCE(rss.receipt_count, 0) AS receipt_count, COALESCE(rss.receipt_qty, 0) AS receipt_qty, COALESCE(ibs.inbound_sns, '') AS inbound_sns, COALESCE(ibs.inbound_count, 0) AS inbound_count, COALESCE(ibs.valid_inbound_qty, 0) AS valid_inbound_qty, pof.completion_inbound_sn AS po_completion_inbound_sn, pof.completion_at AS po_completion_at, pof.delivery_hours AS po_delivery_hours, pof.delivery_status AS po_delivery_status, pof.current_node AS po_current_node, 0 AS allocation_available, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS allocated_qty FROM relation_skus rel INNER JOIN po_facts pof ON pof.order_sn = rel.order_sn INNER JOIN ( SELECT pif.order_sn, pif.sku, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(pif.product_name), '') ORDER BY pif.product_name SEPARATOR '、' ) AS product_name, SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(pif.quantity_real, 0), 0)) AS purchase_qty FROM po_item_facts pif GROUP BY pif.order_sn, pif.sku ) psf ON psf.order_sn = rel.order_sn AND psf.sku <=> rel.sku LEFT JOIN ( SELECT receipt_per_document.order_sn, receipt_per_document.sku, COUNT(*) AS receipt_count, GROUP_CONCAT( receipt_per_document.receipt_sn ORDER BY receipt_per_document.created_at, receipt_per_document.receipt_id SEPARATOR '||' ) AS receipt_sns, SUM(receipt_per_document.receipt_qty) AS receipt_qty FROM ( SELECT ro.id AS receipt_id, ro.order_sn AS receipt_sn, pif.order_sn, pif.sku, ro.create_time AS created_at, SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(roi.product_receive_num, 0), 0)) AS receipt_qty FROM lx_receipt_order ro INNER JOIN lx_receipt_order_item roi ON roi.order_sn = ro.order_sn INNER JOIN po_item_facts pif ON pif.item_id = roi.order_item_id WHERE ro.create_time IS NOT NULL AND ro.create_time <= #{query.asOf} GROUP BY ro.id, ro.order_sn, pif.order_sn, pif.sku, ro.create_time ) receipt_per_document GROUP BY receipt_per_document.order_sn, receipt_per_document.sku ) rss ON rss.order_sn = rel.order_sn AND rss.sku <=> rel.sku LEFT JOIN ( SELECT inbound_per_document.order_sn, inbound_per_document.sku, COUNT(*) AS inbound_count, GROUP_CONCAT( inbound_per_document.inbound_sn ORDER BY inbound_per_document.created_at, inbound_per_document.inbound_id SEPARATOR '||' ) AS inbound_sns, SUM(inbound_per_document.inbound_qty) AS valid_inbound_qty FROM ( SELECT vii.inbound_id, vii.inbound_sn, vii.order_sn, pif.sku, vii.created_at, SUM(vii.inbound_qty) AS inbound_qty FROM valid_ib_items vii INNER JOIN po_item_facts pif ON pif.item_id = vii.purchase_item_id GROUP BY vii.inbound_id, vii.inbound_sn, vii.order_sn, pif.sku, vii.created_at ) inbound_per_document GROUP BY inbound_per_document.order_sn, inbound_per_document.sku ) ibs ON ibs.order_sn = rel.order_sn AND ibs.sku <=> rel.sku WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn}
ORDER BY pof.created_at ASC, pof.order_sn ASC, psf.sku ASC

SELECT pof.order_id, pof.order_sn, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT rel.plan_sn ORDER BY rel.plan_sn SEPARATOR '||') FROM relation_orders rel WHERE rel.order_sn = pof.order_sn) AS plan_sn, pof.skus, pof.product_names, pof.status_text, pof.supplier, pof.warehouse, pof.buyer, pof.settlement_method, pof.settlement_type, pof.source_type, pof.created_at, pof.approval_at, pof.sent_at, pof.purchase_qty, pof.receipt_sns, pof.receipt_count, pof.inbound_sns, pof.inbound_count, pof.valid_inbound_qty, pof.completion_inbound_sn, pof.completion_at, pof.delivery_hours, pof.delivery_status, pof.current_node, CASE WHEN oa.allocation_available = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS allocation_available, CASE WHEN oa.allocation_available = 1 THEN oa.allocated_qty ELSE NULL END AS allocated_qty FROM po_facts pof LEFT JOIN order_allocation oa ON oa.order_sn = pof.order_sn WHERE pof.order_sn = #{orderSn} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM relation_orders rel WHERE rel.order_sn = pof.order_sn )

SELECT ip.inbound_id, ip.inbound_sn, ip.created_at, ip.inbound_qty, ip.cumulative_qty, CASE WHEN pis.completion_inbound_sn = ip.inbound_sn AND pis.completion_at = ip.created_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completion_inbound FROM ib_progress ip LEFT JOIN po_ib_summary pis ON pis.order_sn = ip.order_sn WHERE ip.order_sn = #{orderSn} ORDER BY ip.created_at, ip.inbound_id, ip.inbound_sn
mapper.sql: SELECT CONCAT('PP_APPROVAL_', pp.id) AS event_id, 'PP' AS source_type, pp.plan_sn AS source_sn, pp.approval_time AS event_time, 'PP 最终审批' AS title, CONCAT('PP ', pp.plan_sn, ' 审批通过') AS description, pp.approver AS operator_name, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS quantity, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS cumulative_quantity FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN valid_pp pp ON pp.plan_sn = rel.plan_sn WHERE rel.order_sn = #{orderSn} AND pp.approval_time IS NOT NULL AND pp.approval_time <= #{query.asOf} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PO_CREATE_', po.id), 'PO', po.order_sn, po.create_time, 'PO 创建', '', po.opt_realname, NULL, NULL FROM valid_po po WHERE po.order_sn = #{orderSn} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PO_APPROVAL_', po.id), 'PO', po.order_sn, po.auditor_time, 'PO 审批', 'PO 审批通过', po.auditor_realname, NULL, NULL FROM valid_po po WHERE po.order_sn = #{orderSn} AND po.auditor_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PO_SENT_', pof.sent_log_id), 'PO', pof.order_sn, pof.sent_at, '下发供应商', CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(pof.supplier), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('供应商：', pof.supplier) END, COALESCE(pof.sent_operator, pof.buyer), NULL, NULL FROM po_facts pof WHERE pof.order_sn = #{orderSn} AND pof.sent_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PAY_', rfo.id), 'PAYMENT', rfo.order_sn, COALESCE(CAST(rfo.real_pay_time AS DATETIME), rfo.apply_time), CASE WHEN rfo.real_pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN '付款' ELSE '请款' END, CASE WHEN rfo.real_pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN '付款完成' ELSE '请款已提交' END, COALESCE(rfo.pay_user, rfo.apply_user), NULL, NULL FROM lx_request_funds_order_item rfoi INNER JOIN lx_request_funds_order rfo ON rfo.order_sn = rfoi.order_sn WHERE rfoi.business_sn = #{orderSn} AND rfo.status NOT IN (3, 122, 124) AND COALESCE(CAST(rfo.real_pay_time AS DATETIME), rfo.apply_time) <= #{query.asOf} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('CR_', rf.receipt_id), 'CR', rf.receipt_sn, rf.created_at, 'CR 收货', '', rf.operator_name, rf.receipt_qty, NULL FROM receipt_facts rf WHERE rf.order_sn = #{orderSn} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('IB_', ip.inbound_id), 'IB', ip.inbound_sn, ip.created_at, '有效 IB 创建', CASE WHEN pis.completion_inbound_sn = ip.inbound_sn AND pis.completion_at = ip.created_at THEN '累计达到采购数量，采购流程完成' ELSE '' END, ip.operator_name, ip.inbound_qty, ip.cumulative_qty FROM ib_progress ip LEFT JOIN po_ib_summary pis ON pis.order_sn = ip.order_sn WHERE ip.order_sn = #{orderSn}
mapper.select: SELECT events.* FROM () events WHERE events.event_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY events.event_time, events.event_id

SELECT events.* FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('PP_CREATE_', pp.id) AS event_id, 'PP' AS source_type, pp.plan_sn AS source_sn, pp.create_time AS event_time, 'PP创建' AS title, COALESCE(pp.status_text, '') AS description, pp.creator_real_name AS operator_name, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS quantity, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS cumulative_quantity FROM valid_pp pp WHERE pp.plan_sn = #{planSn} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PP_APPROVAL_', pp.id), 'PP', pp.plan_sn, pp.approval_time, 'PP审批', COALESCE(pp.approval_status, ''), pp.approver, NULL, NULL FROM valid_pp pp WHERE pp.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND pp.approval_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PO_CREATE_', po.id), 'PO', po.order_sn, po.create_time, 'PO创建', COALESCE(po.status_text, ''), po.opt_realname, NULL, NULL FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN valid_po po ON po.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PO_APPROVAL_', po.id), 'PO', po.order_sn, po.auditor_time, 'PO审批', COALESCE(po.status_text, ''), po.auditor_realname, NULL, NULL FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN valid_po po ON po.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND po.auditor_time IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PO_SENT_', pof.sent_log_id), 'PO', pof.order_sn, pof.sent_at, '下发供应商', COALESCE(pof.supplier, ''), COALESCE(pof.sent_operator, pof.buyer), NULL, NULL FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN po_facts pof ON pof.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND pof.sent_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('PAY_', rfo.id), 'PAYMENT', rfo.order_sn, COALESCE(CAST(rfo.real_pay_time AS DATETIME), rfo.apply_time), CASE WHEN rfo.real_pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN '付款完成' ELSE '请款' END, CONCAT('关联PO: ', rfoi.business_sn), COALESCE(rfo.pay_user, rfo.apply_user), NULL, NULL FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN lx_request_funds_order_item rfoi ON rfoi.business_sn = rel.order_sn INNER JOIN lx_request_funds_order rfo ON rfo.order_sn = rfoi.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn} AND rfo.status NOT IN (3, 122, 124) AND COALESCE(CAST(rfo.real_pay_time AS DATETIME), rfo.apply_time) <= #{query.asOf} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('CR_', rf.receipt_id), 'CR', rf.receipt_sn, rf.created_at, 'CR收货', CONCAT('来源PO: ', rf.order_sn), rf.operator_name, NULL, NULL FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN receipt_facts rf ON rf.order_sn = rel.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('IB_', ip.inbound_id), 'IB', ip.inbound_sn, ip.created_at, CASE WHEN pis.completion_inbound_sn = ip.inbound_sn AND pis.completion_at = ip.created_at THEN 'IB创建（累计达标）' ELSE 'IB创建' END, CASE WHEN pis.completion_inbound_sn = ip.inbound_sn AND pis.completion_at = ip.created_at THEN '累计达到采购数量，采购流程完成' ELSE '有效入库累计未达标' END, ip.operator_name, ip.inbound_qty, ip.cumulative_qty FROM relation_orders rel INNER JOIN ib_progress ip ON ip.order_sn = rel.order_sn LEFT JOIN po_ib_summary pis ON pis.order_sn = ip.order_sn WHERE rel.plan_sn = #{planSn} ) events WHERE events.event_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY events.event_time, events.event_id
